about: Raw map data for the map pipeline, kept in data/raw/ (not stored in git). Files with access 'whole' (the default) are downloaded by tools/map/fetch.mjs; access 'range' marks big rasters that tools/map/build-grids.mjs reads window by window through tools/map/fetch-grids.mjs, with {NN} (a class number) or {tile} (a tile name) in the url filled in by the builder. 'files' are small extra files (legends, licences, manuals) fetched whole. licenceStatus is 'read' only once the licence was read on the owner's own host and quoted here (licenceReadAt says where; licenceQuote is verbatim); a shipped map file built from an 'unverified' source fails the build. 'credit' is what the in-game Credits screen shows; its licenceUri has no scheme. The lead keeps data/sources.md in step with this file.

sources.what: GEBCO_2026 Grid: heights and sea depths at 15 arc-seconds, metres (int16). Read as an unofficial Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF copy (BigTIFF, DEFLATE + predictor 2, 512 x 512 tiles), pinned to one S3 object version.
sources.licence: GEBCO Grid terms of use: NOT YET READ (believed public domain with attribution, TO CHECK)
sources.licenceReadAt: Not read yet. The official hosts (gebco.net, and dap.ceda.ac.uk where the netCDF is published) are blocked from this container until Ignas allows them. The copy's own README only links to the terms on gebco.net.
sources.unofficialCopy: Australian Antarctic Division, on Source Cooperative (AWS S3, us-west-2). Their scripts (github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/gebco, README) download GEBCO_2026.zip (the ice-surface-elevation netCDF) from dap.ceda.ac.uk and convert it with gdal_translate to a COG (EPSG:4326, DEFLATE, PREDICTOR=2, 512 blocks, AVERAGE overviews). No other change.

The copy was converted from the ice-surface-elevation netCDF (per the AAD scripts). Over the Baltic there is no ice sheet, so heights should equal the standard grid: confirm against the official grid once reachable.
Spot-check a few cells of the copy against the official netCDF once reachable.
